name: Raaf
label: Bijzondere vogel
desc:
Why I'm thinking it might be C corax:
- It was clearly larger than the crows in the area, caught my attention because it seemed almost as big as a buzzard
- Heavy looking bill, slightly curved
- Long wings with long pointy fingers

Unfortunately, I didn't hear any calls and it was too far away to get a good look at the shape of the tail, so I can't be 100% sure. Happy to be corrected!
